name: Spider: Complex and Cross-Domain Text-to-SQL Benchmark
description: Spider is a large-scale human-labeled dataset for complex and cross-domain semantic parsing and text-to-SQL. It contains 10,181 natural language questions and 5,693 unique complex SQL queries covering 200 databases with multiple tables across 138 domains.
